label: Product tour

kinds.title: Opening card over the product as it rises into view.
kinds.step: One stop of the tour: the camera glides to this step's pose with no cut, the caption changes, and named parts of the model can come out.
kinds.cta: Closing card: the one action viewers should take, with a button.

fields.model: The 3D model (.glb, glTF 2.0 binary) from the project assets. Every step names the same model; the tour shows one model.
fields.view: This step's camera pose as JSON, each key optional: {"azimuth": 30, "elevation": 12, "zoom": 1}. azimuth -180 to 180 degrees round the model, elevation -30 to 60 above it, zoom 0.6 (farther) to 1.6 (closer). A missing key keeps the previous step's value; the first step starts about 29 degrees round, 13 up, zoom 1.
fields.explode: Parts of the model out at this step, as JSON: 1-6 node names of the .glb, e.g. ["front"] (a pack from pack-glb has front, back and rim). Parts not listed go back in.
fields.gap: How far this step's parts move: 0.1 to 1 of the model's size (default 0.45).
fields.title.theme: dark: a centred title on the brand dark colour, for a cold open; accent: the same on the brand secondary colour.
fields.title.env: Lighting for the whole tour: studio (default), brand (a room in the brand colours reflects in the model) or none (plain lamps).
fields.title.decal: Optional sticker for the whole tour: a brand or built-in icon on the model's front face, e.g. {"icon": "shield", "at": [0.85, 0.15], "size": 0.28, "part": "front"}; at as fractions of the face, size 0.1-0.6 of its height, part the node it rides on.
fields.cta.image: Optional background photo from the project assets (e.g. the pack or a lifestyle shot), faded under the brand colour on the text side so the button still reads.
fields.title.bloom: Optional glow from the model's bright highlights for the whole tour, 0 to 1 (e.g. 0.4). Leave it out for a plain, sharp look.
fields.title.focus: true: through the whole tour the model's centre stays sharp and its nearer and farther edges soften, like a close-up lens. false (default): all sharp.

description: A 3D product tour: one model (a .glb asset, e.g. a pack built with pack-glb) stays on screen for the whole video while the camera glides from step to step with no cut, like a guided walk round the product. Each step changes the caption and can pull named parts of the model out. A title opens over the model rising into view, a call to action closes.

title.title: Meet the product
title.subtitle: A closer look from every side

step.title: Built to last
